title: Characters of $F_4(\mathbb{C})$ at involutions
summary: The exceptional group $F_4(\mathbb{C})$ has two conjugacy classes of involutions: an involution $t$ with centralizer $\mathrm{Spin}(9,\mathbb{C})$, and the principal involution, with centralizer $(\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{C})\times\mathrm{Sp}(6,\mathbb{C}))/\{\pm1\}$. We determine the values of all irreducible characters of $F_4(\mathbb{C})$ at $t$. For the irreducible representation with highest weight $aω_1+bω_2+cω_3+dω_4$ (in Bourbaki's labelling), we show that the character vanishes at $t$ if and only if $c$ and $d$ are both odd.
